subject: Video of a bag being tossed from a second-floor White House window
claim: Asked about the viral video, Trump said it was probably AI-generated, arguing the residence windows are sealed, armored and too heavy to open.
finding: Earlier that day, a White House official had told TIME and other outlets that the video showed a contractor doing maintenance while the president was away. Hany Farid told ABC and CNN he saw no evidence of AI generation or manipulation. ABC said it had not independently verified the video.
outcome: The White House's explanation and the president's contradicted each other on the same day. In the same remarks, Trump said that blaming AI could be his answer if something truly bad came out.
